genericBuildingAudit.notes: Current default geometry/envelope workflow is strongest for single-family houses.
Building DNA can represent adjacent/heated/unheated boundaries, but assisted abstraction must avoid roof/ground questions when irrelevant.
Project/building/technicalSystems model is generic enough; UI is currently residential-house biased.
Chapter 3 technical systems are generic; Chapter 2 input UI must generalize building use, zones, schedules and internal gains.
Architecture should keep category separate from residential presets and avoid assumptions until MC001 scope is confirmed for the target use.

rules: Every production field has exactly one authoritative owner.
Providers resolve source-backed datasets and expose bounded diagnostics for unavailable data.
Building DNA is the only persisted engineering input model.
Adapters map Building DNA to physics input without duplicating formulas.
Reports render persisted Building DNA and engine outputs without recalculation.
Legacy fields remain explicitly classified until removed.

validationContract.futureChangeRule: Any milestone adding a production field, provider, runtime concept or report section must update building-model-registry.json and BUILDING_MODEL_ARCHITECTURE.md.
